text: I think you might enjoy this Baba Ganouj recipe, despite its departure from your typical baking interests. The ingredients and cooking time don't suggest a quick bread or muffin, but the recipe's focus on eggplants and tahini might appeal to your taste buds. Additionally, the dish is relatively light in sugar, which could be a refreshing change from the higher sugar content in some of your liked recipes. Give it a try and see what you think!
